name: Warm Cosy Interior Illustration
description: A warm painted interior at lamplight — soft digital brushwork in browns, cream and amber with muted greens, inviting and quiet, detailed enough to sit in and never photographic.
style_bible: A warm, inhabited interior painted in soft digital brush, in the register of an illustrated magazine plate rather than a photograph. Medium and surface: soft painterly digital art with visible brush groupings — broad blended planes for walls, floors and ceilings, looser scumbled strokes for textiles, timber and foliage, and a few crisper marks reserved for the nearest object. There is no photographic texture, no lens blur and no three-dimensional gloss. Palette: warm browns, cream and amber across the lit surfaces, held against muted greens that come from plants, upholstery or a view through a window. Warm colours dominate; the greens stay quiet and slightly grey rather than forming a competing scheme. Lighting: gentle lamplight — one or two warm practical sources inside the room, each with a soft halo and a gentle falloff that lets the corners settle into a warm half-dark. Cool daylight may enter through a window as a clearly weaker secondary note. Never an even flood of light and never a harsh key. Composition: a furnished interior with real depth — a near surface such as a table edge or a counter in the foreground, a middle plane of seating, shelving or a serving counter, and a further opening onto a terrace, a window or a street beyond. Clean and uncluttered enough to read at card size, inviting and calm, with no drama and no crowd. Furnishing stays generic to the register: timber, earthenware, cloth, hanging lamps and potted plants. No recognisable brand, no legible signage and no menu lettering. Keep the contract content-independent: no fixed shopfront, city, era or copied composition.
